contents.workSub: Designed and developed a responsive e-commerce website to showcase digital services and create a clear, user-friendly purchasing experience. Customized the product pages and order flow to help customers select services, and complete their purchase efficiently.
contents.leftText: Created and launched a user-friendly e-commerce website for digital services and educational products.
contents.midText: Created a seamless shopping experience for both English and Chinese customers.
contents.rightText: Enabled customers to submit project requirements and make purchases through the platform.

impr1: Created a clear and user-friendly online experience for browsing and purchasing digital services.
Improved the product selection and order process by organizing service information and customer requirements in one place.
Designed a responsive website that provides a consistent experience across desktop and mobile devices.
Customized the WooCommerce purchasing flow to better support the business's digital service offerings.
